messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Corr matrix as input
parts:
See this page

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/cov.html

It would be ideal if you also had the SDs, so that you can put the correlations into a covariance metric (so you can trust your SEs).  You can use lavaan's cor2cov() function to rescale easily -- make sure your rows/columns are named so lavaan can match your syntax to the variables in the matrix.  If all you have is the correlation matrix, then you just have to use that as input as though it were a covariance matrix.

Terry
